_why: Hunter M4 (Nov 26): Furfur Kemp, the caged demon (DESIGN.md 'Furfur Kemp', BUILD_SPEC M4). Every number has a TUNE slider (lair_tuning.gd). Lines, lore and clauses are placeholders until Duff signs off the writing.

trigger._why: DESIGN: an early hunt goes wrong, you limp home, and he follows you to finish you. A player who never loses still meets him: he comes on the arrival home that makes after_hunts.

invasion._why: The home-invasion fight. You can't lose it: when you drop you get back up at revive_hp_fraction and he heals regen_fraction of his HP (DESIGN: 'you win ugly'). Same chase/attack keys as the raid so hunt_arena's foe AI runs him.

lore: I was a partner at Price & Partners. Corner office. Fourth circle. The view was people.
Every partner signs Price's contract. Every partner thinks he's the exception.
I tried to buy myself out. Price laughed so hard he billed me for the time.
Those 'targets' he sends you? Check whose debt goes down when you kill them. It isn't yours.
Your mother didn't lose. She walked into his office. Ask yourself why he'd let her leave.
I can't die, Cain. Not by knife, not by fire. There's only one way, and I'll never tell you. Probably.

contract._why: Price's contract (BUILD_SPEC: an inventory item; hidden clauses revealed over time). Open clauses show from the start. Hidden ones are read out by Furfur, one per mercy, in order.
open: 1. The Bearer's life, spared at birth, is the consideration for this agreement.
2. The Bearer shall collect on accounts named by the Firm, at the Firm's discretion.
3. Upon settlement of the Balance, the Bearer and the Guarantor go free.
hidden: 4(b). 'The Balance' means the balance owed by the Firm's principal, not the Bearer.
7. The Guarantor's freedom is not a term of this agreement and never was.
9(c). Any collection made in the Firm's own office is void, and so is the collector's debt.
12. A partner of the Firm may be released only by the hand that holds his contract.

vent._why: DESIGN: venting after a REAL failure unlocks a combo string, one per real failure (failures_unvented, can't be farmed). Each one adds a hit to the end of the light string (L, L, L, then these). Real clips only: they reuse the hook, heavy and launcher clips.
